title: Regime-Closure Epistemology (RCE): A General Principle of Cross-Domain Validation in Coupled Multi-Scale Systems
abstract: Introduces Regime-Closure Epistemology (RCE) as an operational principle for validating coupled multi-scale systems. The paper specifies five joint conditions—regime locality, variety closure, modelling closure, frozen-parameter governance, and external arbitration via sealed predictions—arguing that validation is sound if and only if these hold. It consolidates EFC machinery (EBE, RCMP, L0–L3 architecture, sealed predictions, and a live falsification ledger) and deposits pre-registered cross-domain predictions.
